title: Archive 13
author: Anastasiia
description: A night shift in an archive that operates by its own rules. An elderly watchman hands over the keys and issues a single rule: after 3:00 AM, don't set foot on the second floor. Max’s signature is already in the logbook, even though he hasn’t signed it yet. Every decision brings him closer either to the solution or to one of the possible endings—where survival isn't the only issue; there is also the matter of what people will say about you afterward. Three outcomes. Only one is a true victory.
